message:
We’ve all had those moments where we wish we were a bit more prepared for the unexpected, right? 🌧️ Having a solid survival kit can make a world of difference when emergencies arise. That’s why we found this handy resource from the Red Cross to help us gather the essentials we might need. It’s all about feeling ready and confident, instead of scrambling when the time comes. 

What’s your go-to tip for being prepared? We’d love to hear your thoughts!
